existingNative50mpPng.scope: Actual import, native WASM tone edit, save/reopen and full-resolution PNG decode, with source preservation and tile/strip boundary samples.

designAndLimits: Unmodified decoded source images are re-encoded at source resolution with existing native streamed PNG export; shared instances reuse one image definition and retain authored size/affine placement.

Tone effects and erasures execute after native sampling. Modified rasters bake raw content at document resolution over expanded shadow support; masks/styles/fill/layer opacity/blends remain independent SVG hierarchy. Off-support processed pixels and operation editability are explicitly lost/reported.

Embedded PNGs contain only IHDR/sRGB/IDAT/IEND in real decoded PNG/JPEG/WebP fixtures. EXIF orientation is normalized to decoded geometry; original source-file metadata is excluded. Original source Blob bytes remain unchanged.
Complete unmodified decoded source pixels, including masked/off-canvas pixels, remain embedded and disclosed. SVG is not redaction; choose PNG for flattened delivery.

One initial dependency capture pins raster and bitmap-mask identities, bitmaps, Blobs, dimensions and asset repository lifetime across image/mask phases and final encoding. Destructive lifecycle tests use a separate actual application instance to avoid deliberately invalidating mounted UI assets.

No arbitrary import cap or full-document host RGBA/canvas allocation. Resident source decoding, compressed/base64 output, browser decoders and SVG filters/viewers still consume memory; PNG format geometry applies.

50 MP evidence proves a full native embedded-PNG decode, thirteen real source-coordinate samples (eight nontransparent), native SVG geometry and independent vector structure. It does not prove full 50 MP composite SVG raster decode, whole-process peak memory or viewer-wide conformance.

Seven of nine small image comparisons are byte-exact for alpha/premultiplied RGB; masked-style reaches two alpha levels and 2.211764705882352 premultiplied byte values; edited-style reaches one and 2.3137254901960773. These are fixture/viewer observations, not universal interchange tolerances.

Single container elapsed times are observational. The early development PNG regression overlaps unit validation; no speedup, p95/input-to-photon, long-task, heap or universal device responsiveness claim is made.
No new public constructor/mutation DTO, schema/project/workspace format, REST renderer/browser synchronization, script/plugin image-byte/file privilege, paid service or source mutation.
Remaining SVG Blend If, paint/text/adjustment/smart contents, import/round-trip, wider formats/viewers/precision and the full professional-editor roadmap remain incomplete.
